_meta.source: CPX 2026 rebrand - Colors-RGB.pdf / Colors-Pantone.pdf / Colors-CMYK.pdf (PMS swatches). Replaces the 2024/25 yellow identity.
_meta.colour_role_mapping: Evanssion interpretation - CONFIRM with CPX: Dark Purple = primary/hero dark; CPX Green = signature accent (the eye-catcher, replaces the old yellow); Bright Purple = secondary; Accent Blue / Accent Red = tertiary.
_meta.tints_note: The 2026 kit supplies base colours only (no tint ramps). A neutral ramp is retained for UI surfaces; brand-colour tint ramps await an official spec - do not fabricate brand tints.
_meta.logo_note: The 2026 mark was extracted from Colors-CMYK.pdf (pages 1-2) into assets/logos/2026/ (svg + png; primary / reverse / on-purple). It is a NEW design: lowercase 'cpx' with the x as a double-chevron, left chevron CPX Green #4CEE76, rest Near Black #040405. The old assets/logos/svg + png (yellow CP) are PRE-2026 - history only.

green._note: The eye-catcher accent - replaces the old yellow. Use sparingly for emphasis / CTAs / highlights.

tints._note: Brand-colour tint ramps await the official 2026 spec - do not fabricate. Neutral ramp retained for UI surfaces.

latin_display.note: Brand display / headings font. Bundled in assets/fonts/CPX-Unbounded (ttf + woff2).

latin_body.note: Body / UI copy. Bundled in assets/fonts/Inter.

system_fallback.note: Reserved for desktop apps (Word, PowerPoint) only. NEVER use Arial on the web - use CPX Unbounded (headings) / Inter (body).

logo.clear_space_rule: Maintain clear space around the brandmark equal to the height of the 'C' in CPX on all sides.
logo._note: Official 2026 mark in assets/logos/2026/ (extracted from Colors-CMYK.pdf). New design - lowercase 'cpx', x as a double-chevron, left chevron CPX Green #4CEE76, rest Near Black #040405.

variants_2026.reverse: assets/logos/2026/cpx-logo-reverse.svg|png - white mark + green chevron on dark backgrounds (transparent).
variants_2026.on_purple: assets/logos/2026/cpx-logo-on-purple.svg|png - white + green on the Dark Purple #1E1847 brand background.

logo.legacy: assets/logos/svg + png hold the PRE-2026 yellow 'CP + arrow' mark - history only; do not use.
